page.overview:
Who is Bobarian Afol?

Bobarian Afol, better known as Jedi Bob, was a Jedi who once sought to prevent the space-time continuum of the galaxy from being disrupted.

A Force Builder Jedi, he disobeyed his superiors and tampered with The Cornerstone of the Galaxy, unintentionally causing his galaxy to reset, resulting in a completely new one that he could not revert back to its original state. For years afterward, he protected The Cornerstone in a hidden Jedi temple on Fennesa, until it was removed from its spot in the temple wall by Sig Greebling, resetting the galaxy yet again.

Afol accompanied Sig on a journey across the galaxy to restore The Cornerstone to its spot in the temple, until Sig found out via his changed brother Darth Devastator that his galaxy could not be restored, which Afol confirmed he had lied about. After being left for dead by Dev, and Sig giving Darth Devastator The Cornerstone, he returned to help Sig take back The Cornerstone from him. Afol then took Sig and the crew they had amassed along the way back to the temple, and reburied the temple underground to protect The Cornerstone for the foreseeable future.

Bobarian Afol appeared in the canon continuity in the non-canon LEGO Star Wars special LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy, which was released on September 13, 2024. He and was first identified as Bob in the 2009 LEGO reference book LEGO Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary. Bob's last name, Afol, is similar to the acronym "AFOL," which means "adult fans of Lego."
